title: Supporting Europe’s work in ensuring a trustworthy AI ecosystem
summary: OpenAI supports the EU Code of Practice on AI content transparency, advancing provenance standards and tools to help people understand AI-generated content.
body: OpenAI supports the EU Code of Practice on AI content transparency, advancing provenance standards and tools to help people understand AI-generated content.
summaryZh: OpenAI宣布支持欧盟关于AI内容透明度的行为准则（EU Code of Practice），致力于推进溯源标准和工具的建设，以帮助公众识别和理解AI生成的内容。这反映了大模型厂商在监管合规与生态治理方面的最新动向。

aiReview.reasonZh: OpenAI宣布支持欧洲的AI行为准则及内容透明度标准，推进可信赖AI生态建设。
